market_read: Week 2 snapshot: 17 verified rows, 0 indicative. All 14 rows persisting from last week held their asking prices without change over 6 days, consistent with a static seller market. Verified range remains PHP 269–3,000/sqm with an overall median of PHP 1,200/sqm; the Pagsanjan-proper median is PHP 975/sqm versus PHP 2,000/sqm for the ring, still a parcel-size effect rather than a location discount. Two listings went to 404 this week: Magdalena Cigaras (24,000 sqm, PHP 3,000/sqm) and Cavinti Sumucab (8,394 sqm, PHP 2,204/sqm); the Sumucab property reappeared at same price under a new URL (likely a relist), while Cigaras has no replacement — if it sold rather than expired, it is the first confirmed exit in this dataset and signals PHP 3,000/sqm was achievable in the Magdalena ring. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel, the tightest comparables — Maulawin (4,767 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) and new entry Bulilan Norte/Pila (6,447 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) — support an asking range of PHP 1,600–2,000/sqm; PHP 1,400/sqm remains the suggested fastest-sale price, unchanged from the baseline.
